messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" maybe means "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? But they already gave sample std dev. Maybe they want to compute the standard error? Or compute the t-statistic? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Might be asking to compute the standard error of the mean under null hypothesis? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation of the sampling distribution under null hypothesis" which is sigma/sqrt(n). But we don't know population sigma; we have sample sigma 1.4. So standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. Then compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / 0.2215 = -0.4 / 0.2215 = -1.805. Then compute p-value two-tailed: 2 * P(T > |t|) with df=39. Use t-distribution. Let's approximate: t=1.805, df=39. Using t-table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10, t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So t=1.805 gives p between 0.10 and 0.05, maybe ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. So answer: standard error ~0.2215, t-statistic ~-1.805, p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation.
